contract.id: always included except parent-addressed singletons without own id
contract.all: all requestable fields; wins over other tokens
exceptions: APIView bodies including current user, workspace features, effective permissions, artifacts

deferred_collection_fields.general: unbounded description_html where resource declares it

contract.expand_composition: independent namespaces; requested expansions survive field selection even if corresponding id field omitted
contract.required_read_properties: only id on ordinary resource components; other keys may be absent
contract.resolution: Server-side shaping only on declared endpoints; no local filling of absent keys, no universal fields parameter.
